en:
## New Features

- Routed NUG models by channel with channel-aware caching and delegation so provider selection stays accurate across model sources.
- Surfaced NUG provider metadata in model selectors to make channel and provider choices clearer.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed the packaged Bash command analyzer so embedded tree-sitter WASM assets load correctly in standalone binaries.
- Preserved live bash output and compact-summary UI state while narrator messages update.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 按 channel 路由 NUG 模型，并加入感知 channel 的缓存与委托逻辑，使不同模型来源下的 provider 选择更准确。
- 在模型选择器中展示 NUG provider 元数据，让 channel 和 provider 选择更清晰。

## 修复

- 修复打包后的 Bash 命令分析器，使 standalone 二进制能正确加载内嵌的 tree-sitter WASM 资源。
- 在叙述者消息更新时保留实时 bash 输出和 compact-summary UI 状态。
